sections.content:
Why would you want to work for us?
We are an ambitious, fast-growing company that values our people above all else. Our mission is to disrupt talent attraction and employer brand advertising for good, and we need people who want to join us on this journey.

sections.heading: Who we're looking for?
sections.content: We’re looking for a talented and creative Digital Content Executive to help drive forward our client's creative advertising. You will live and breathe social media, have copywriting experience and enjoy getting creative with content.

sections.heading: What we can offer you?
sections.content:
£25,000 per annum
Hybrid working [a few days in the office, a couple remote]
An inspiring and entrepreneurial work environment
An enthusiastic team from whom you’ll learn a lot as well as have fun with
Monthly team socials + yearly overseas incentive trips - Dubai in 2023!
A great office environment and location by Marble Arch

sections.heading: What will your day to day look like?
sections.content:
Content creation - copywriting and creative [video editing and graphic]
Ideation
Launching campaigns using our platform
Collaboration with the marketing team
Reporting

sections.heading: Responsibilities?
sections.content:
Develop creative concepts and visual assets for paid social media campaigns.
Collaborate with the marketing team to align creative vision with campaign objectives and target audience.
Create platform-specific ads that utilise the unique features of each platform.
Test, analyse, and optimise creative assets based on campaign performance data.
Stay informed about the latest trends, updates, and best practices on all relevant social media platforms.

sections.heading: Requirements?
sections.content:
Creative storyteller with strong copywriting experience
Excellent writing skills. Ideally with copywriting experience
Graphic design and video editing skills using Adobe suite
Good verbal communication skills
Enjoys being part of a team
Able to work remote on own initiative
You will be joining a fun, outspoken team with a mix of skills and experience. Your career development path could roll out towards lots of exciting opportunities as our business grows.
